product_metadata.title: Home Brilliant Pillow Covers 12x20 Rectangle Super Soft Fluffy Faux Fur Oblong Lumbar Throw Pillow Cover for Bed, Set of 2, 12x20 inch, Red
features: Features: Package include 2 pcs pillow covers. No pillow insert. Color: Red. Measures: 12x20 inch, tailored for 12x20 inch pillows.
Material: This supersoft fluffy faux fur throw pillow cover is made of 100% high quality polyester.
Less Shedding: lining at the back of the fur largely reduce shedding and provide extra strength.
Easy Insertion: The throw pillow cover is invisible zipper closure, opening around 37cm-39cm, super easy for insertion.
Washing Guide: Machine Wash Cold Separately, Gently Cycle Only, No Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, DO NOT IRON.

details.Care instructions: Machine Washable, Tumble Dry, Do not Iron
details.Warranty Description: All products purchased have a 90-day warranty as standard. The warranty period begins on the day the product is originally shipped. The warranty covers all of the items and conditions identified in the original manufacturers warranty. Some of the items specifically not covered by the warranty are loss and theft, water damage, customer abuse.
